verdict.rationale: The only AI-related evidence is the official Svelte MCP server, which gives agents relevant documentation and statically analyses the code they generate (svelte-docs-19). That is AI-assisted code checking, not a devtool that inspects a running component tree and recommends rendering or reactivity optimizations. missing for 10: component-tree analysis, specific rendering/reactivity optimization suggestions, devtools/runtime profiling integration, any hands-on or independent corroboration.
